name: Nagykálló (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over blue, charged at the centre with the town arms of Nagykálló (a blue and red shield with a tower, a key, a hammer and a horseshoe) above the name NAGYKÁLLÓ in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
